				<div class="clearfix"  >
					<div  class="tatsu-fqp8z1tlyt4wosw1 tatsu-section  tatsu-parallax tatsu-fullscreen tatsu-bg-overlay   tatsu-clearfix" data-title=""  data-headerscheme="background--dark"><div class="tatsu-fullscreen-wrap"><div class='tatsu-section-pad clearfix' data-padding='{"d":"175px 0px 175px 0px "}' data-padding-top='175px'><div class="tatsu-row-wrap  tatsu-wrap tatsu-row-one-col tatsu-row-has-one-cols tatsu-medium-gutter tatsu-reg-cols  tatsu-clearfix tatsu-fqp8z1tlzm5lx6tm" ><div  class="tatsu-row " ><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-column-no-bg tatsu-one-col tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-fqp8z1tlzy7mfmbg"  data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-fqp8z1tm0mfvqoks   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner ">
<p><strong><span style="color: #ffffff; font-size: 18px;">Welcome to Sorrento Beach Club</span></strong></p>
<h1><strong><span style="color: #ffffff;">About Us</span></strong></h1>
</div></div></div></div><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image" ></div></div></div><style></style></div></div></div></div><div class="tatsu-section-background-wrap tatsu-parallax-element-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-section-background tatsu-parallax-element" ></div></div><div class="tatsu-overlay tatsu-section-overlay"></div></div><style></style></div><div  class="tatsu-fqp8z1tm3z43q8yy tatsu-section    tatsu-clearfix" data-title=""  data-headerscheme="background--dark"><div class='tatsu-section-pad clearfix' data-padding='{"d":"90px 0px 30px 0px"}' data-padding-top='90px'><div class="tatsu-row-wrap  tatsu-wrap tatsu-row-one-col tatsu-row-has-one-cols tatsu-medium-gutter tatsu-reg-cols  tatsu-clearfix tatsu-fqp8z1tm4icmaduf" ><div  class="tatsu-row " ><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-column-no-bg tatsu-one-col tatsu-animate tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-fqp8z1tm4t7p24mw" data-animation="fadeIn"   data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-fqp8z1tm5c1vohwx   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<h4>About Us</h4>
</div></div></div></div><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image" ></div></div></div><style></style></div></div></div><div class="tatsu-row-wrap  tatsu-wrap tatsu-row-has-one-half tatsu-row-has-two-cols tatsu-medium-gutter tatsu-reg-cols  tatsu-clearfix tatsu-fqp8z1tm8t4hc163" ><div  class="tatsu-row " ><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-column-no-bg tatsu-one-half tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-fqp8z1tm95fe7hz1"  data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-SJRaaph-p   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<p>Sorrento Beach Club, Phan Rang&#8217;s first resort-style boutique hotel, is nestled at the edge of Nui Chau National Park, surrounded by pristine mountains, traditional Vietnamese vegetation, and the serene My Hoa Lagoon, a popular destination for water sports enthusiasts.</p>
<p>Conceived after much persuasion from our kite and windsurfing friends, Sorrento Beach Club is an all-inclusive European-style venue with designer accommodation, extensive restaurant and bar facilities, and a world-class kite surfing and water sports center unmatched in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.</p>
<p>With backgrounds in real estate, interior design, and hospitality (including the popular Dragon Beach Bar in Muine), we have combined our passions, experiences, and souls to bring you something new and creative to Phan Rang.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image" ></div></div></div><style></style></div><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-column-no-bg tatsu-one-half tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-fqp8z1tmgbfn6x3a"  data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-fqp8z1tm9o1jtzyn   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<p>We invite you to share the Sorrento Beach Club experience.</p>
<p>Set in a lush tropical garden with an expansive beachfront, you can relax around our infinity pool or simply enjoy the pure ambiance of watching the fishing boats on the horizon or the kitesurfing action below.</p>
<p>Our spacious restaurant offers fine dining unparalleled in the area, throughout the day and evening. The extensive bar is open well into the night with great music, thanks to our friends and local identities, Chef Rachel and partner Ty from Australia.</p>
<p>We welcome you to enjoy our unique Vietnamese water sports boutique hotel, Sorrento Beach Club.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image" ></div></div></div><style></style></div></div></div></div><div class="tatsu-section-background-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-section-background" ></div></div><style></style></div><div  class="tatsu-H15F7AhZp tatsu-section    tatsu-clearfix" data-title=""  data-headerscheme="background--dark"><div class='tatsu-section-pad clearfix' data-padding='{"d":"30px 0px 90px 0px"}' data-padding-top='30px'><div class="tatsu-row-wrap  tatsu-wrap tatsu-row-one-col tatsu-row-has-one-cols tatsu-medium-gutter tatsu-reg-cols  tatsu-clearfix tatsu-SygqYQRhWa" ><div  class="tatsu-row " ><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-column-no-bg tatsu-one-col tatsu-animate tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-rJ-cKmRh-a" data-animation="fadeIn"   data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-HJG9YQA2Za   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<h4>How To Get Here&#8230;</h4>
</div></div><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-BkyaJzES6   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<p><span style="font-size: 14px; background-color: #ffffff;">Sorrento Beach Club is situated on My Hoa lagoon, in the Ninh Hai area just north of Phan Rang City.  Only 16 kilometres north of Ninh Chu Bay the coastal road provides easy access to the area. For more details, see</span><br /><a style="font-size: 14px; background-image: none; background-color: #ffffff;" href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/dQ13tHWv88MqV2Kn9" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="tatsu-inline-link-style1 " style="font-size: 14px; background-image: none; background-color: #ffffff;">Sorrento Beach Club Vietnam on Google </span></a><a style="font-size: 14px; background-image: none; background-color: #ffffff;" href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/dQ13tHWv88MqV2Kn9" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Maps</a><a style="font-size: 14px; background-image: none; background-color: #ffffff;" href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/dQ13tHWv88MqV2Kn9" target="_blank" rel="noopener">.</a></p>
